It sounds frustrating to put in consistent effort at the gym and still see the scale move in the wrong direction, and it's completely reasonable to explore all your options.

Whether weight-loss medications might be appropriate for your specific history and health profile is really a question for a healthcare provider who can review your medical background, any underlying factors contributing to weight gain, and whether those prescriptions are a safe and effective fit for you. A doctor or clinician can also help you weigh potential benefits against side effects and discuss how medication might work alongside the therapy and fitness routine you're already committed to. Your instinct to gather information and ask thoughtful questions is a great starting point—consider bringing your questions and history to a provider you trust so you can make an informed decision together.
